remarks: Discover elegant coastal living in this updated 3-4 bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home. With a generous 3185 square feet of living space, this residence offers a prime location only a short distance from one of Darien's public beaches and steps from its award-winning, Blue Ribbon elementary school. Step inside to discover a beautifully renovated gourmet kitchen featuring high-end stainless appliances, complemented by hardwood flooring and upscale millwork throughout. This home features a large deck overlooking a private, level backyard, and a bonus playroom with a half bath over the attached 2-car garage. The office, with its own bath, could easily serve as a fourth bedroom, offering flexibility for your lifestyle needs. Conveniently located only 1 mile from the train station, this home is close to schools, shopping, and transportation, making it an ideal retreat for those seeking both comfort and convenience.
